name: Primal Rite
label: Revelation
lede: Primal Rite came out of San Francisco in 2016 with a cassette and two 7"s, then signed to Revelation, which pressed a 7" in 2017 and the band's first LP in 2018.

eras.title: One year, three releases
eras.text: The band showed up all at once: a numbered promo tape, then two seven-inches in the same year, out of San Francisco's hardcore scene.

years.h: Primal Rite start with a hand-numbered cassette
years.p: A limited promo tape, numbered by hand, is the first thing the San Francisco band puts out.

years.h: Hatred in a Mask of Flowers puts Primal Rite on vinyl
years.p: The 7" pairs the title song with Pestilent Clutch: two songs on a 45, the band's first record you can drop a needle on.
play: Hatred in a Mask of Flowers / Pestilent Clutch
Hatred in a Mask of Flowers

years.h: Complex Life of Passion follows the same year
years.p: Primal Rite's second 7" of 2016, also issued on cassette. The band's full set at Oakland Metro on November 5 is on video.

eras.title: Revelation signs them
eras.text: Revelation had been the home of New York straight edge and its descendants for thirty years. In 2017 and 2018 it pressed a Primal Rite 7" and the San Francisco band's first full-length.

years.h: Revelation releases Sensory Link to Pain as REV 169
years.p: Three songs: Sensory Link to Pain, Is It Me? and Primal Discipline. Lucy X sings, Jake Dudley and [[Jason Brownstein|02777bb1-dfbd-4090-b478-58eb7b04f006]] play guitar, Max Wickham bass, Jeremy Meier drums.
years.xp:
Revelation's pressing notes list 10 black test pressings, then 330 on opaque yellow vinyl and 700 on black for the first press. A Discogs listing gives the yellow count as 300; Revelation's own number is used here.

The band played a record release show at the Honey Hive on March 24, 2017, and the full set is on video.

years.src: Revelation Records: pressing history · Discogs: Primal Rite, Dirge of Escapism
years.h: Dirge of Escapism is REV 171, Primal Rite's first album
years.p: Ten songs, opening on Chapter Zero and closing on Immutable Law. Revelation pressed 167 blue, 327 black and 700 red copies, plus 11 black test pressings, with a CD alongside.
years.xp: Discogs credits Adam Burke with the artwork and Alex Herrera with helping develop the album's concept. It lists Jeremy Meier on drums, Max Wickham on bass and Jake Dudley and Federico Avila on guitar.

years.h: Bow to No One comes as a shaped flexi
years.p: Primal Rite put out Bow to No One as a limited 7" flexi-disc cut into a shape rather than a circle.
